name: orthomcl-singletons-counted-by-organism
turns: Which organisms in OrthoMCL have the most singletons (orthogroups with just a single protein)?
rationale: Groups of one protein, transformed to their proteins, and those proteins counted by organism answer the question; the reply names the organisms with the most and their counts from the site.

provenance.curatorNote: Needs a count of a built step by a column.
